$comment: Run O1 lane K1 (which): the Which Jujutsu Kaisen character are you quiz, written by us, arc 0 (premise only). Eight questions about the reader; eight profiles, all spoiler level 0 characters. Facts cited per character (D/facts/jujutsu-kaisen.json): yuji-itadori: jujutsu-kaisen-yuji-itadori-name-031, jujutsu-kaisen-twenty-fingers-027, jujutsu-kaisen-yuji-itadori-outgoing-062, jujutsu-kaisen-yuji-itadori-school-063; satoru-gojo: jujutsu-kaisen-strongest-sorcerer-028, jujutsu-kaisen-satoru-gojo-teacher-064; megumi-fushiguro: jujutsu-kaisen-megumi-fushiguro-first-year-065, jujutsu-kaisen-megumi-fushiguro-ten-shadows-066, jujutsu-kaisen-megumi-fushiguro-spares-067; nobara-kugisaki: jujutsu-kaisen-nobara-kugisaki-first-year-068, jujutsu-kaisen-nobara-kugisaki-straw-doll-069, jujutsu-kaisen-nobara-kugisaki-village-070; maki-zenin: jujutsu-kaisen-maki-zenin-no-cursed-energy-071, jujutsu-kaisen-maki-zenin-physical-072; toge-inumaki: jujutsu-kaisen-toge-inumaki-rice-balls-073, jujutsu-kaisen-toge-inumaki-cursed-speech-074; panda: jujutsu-kaisen-panda-cursed-corpse-075, jujutsu-kaisen-panda-three-cores-076; ryomen-sukuna: jujutsu-kaisen-ryomen-sukuna-heian-legend-077, jujutsu-kaisen-ryomen-sukuna-name-035. Traits are positions on the six axes of the engine, tuned so each profile wins about an eighth of the answer sheets.

questions.question: A worn charm you do not remember buying turns up in your school bag. What do you do?

options.text: Show it around at lunch and let everyone guess
Study it quietly before touching anything else
Test it on something small, just to see what happens
Wear it, say nothing, and let the rumours grow

questions.question: Your group splits up for the afternoon. Who do you want as a partner?

options.text: The loudest friend, so it never gets dull
The calm one who actually reads the map
Whoever is left, I will make it work
Nobody, I will meet you all there

questions.question: Someone says you are not built for this. What happens next?

options.text: I train twice as hard until the doubt is gone
I prove them wrong on the spot, loudly
I find another way to win the same thing
I smile, say nothing, and keep going

questions.question: How do you act when you are nervous?

options.text: I use fewer words, as few as I can
I crack jokes until the feeling passes
I say exactly what is bothering me
I get busy helping someone else
A long run, then lifting until my arms shake
Sketching plans and making odd little tricks
Hanging out with the whole crowd and trying new food
Napping in a sunny spot, ready when called

questions.question: A new classmate arrives and half the school does not trust them. You:

options.text: Speak up for them before anyone else does
Introduce myself loudly and ask for their story
Wait, watch, and judge by what they do
Challenge them to a friendly game and see

questions.question: Which role do you take on a team?

options.text: The teacher everyone leans on
The backbone who does the heavy lifting
The planner who sees three steps ahead
The wild card who changes shape as needed
Legendary, mentioned in hushed voices
Everyone's dependable friend
The one who never backs down
A mystery with a fun side
